dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Your room is nice! There's a big window.
dialogue.reading: jʊr ˈruːm ɪz ˈnaɪs! ðɛrz ə ˈbɪɡ ˈwɪndoʊ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. And there's a closet next to the door.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ənd ðɛrz ə ˈklɑːzɪt ˈnɛkst tə ðə ˈdɔːr.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: And what are these on the floor?
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈwʌt ər ˈðiːz ɑːn ðə ˈflɔːr?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh no! Those are my socks! Sorry!
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ! ˈðoʊz ər maɪ ˈsɑːks! ˈsɑːri!
